launcher.alt: Astér, la nave modular de Neon Catcher

limits: Actual Chromium, a 390x844 touch viewport and CDP contacts; no game state, save, hull, ammo, clock, entity or progression fixture writes.
The preview QA unlock is activated through its checkbox. Every round is selected through the actual menu.
A read-only IIFE hook observes input, weapon counters and gameplay clocks. RAF instrumentation wraps the existing owner and never requests a frame.
These are short controls regressions, not complete natural missions, visual acceptance, physical iPhone or Safari certification.
Service workers are blocked. No cache lifecycle claim.

Optional fallback profile shadows PointerEvent and suppresses native pointer dispatch in capture phase, leaving CDP native TouchEvents. This is an explicit Chrome capability fixture, not native Safari.
interruptionReason: Stopped own QA process using SIGINT after detecting case mismatch between CDP touchStart and DOM touchstart in the delivery-wait helper. This is a harness error, not a game failure. No game source or package changed.
resultKind: Interrupted QA harness; no game verdict
timingLimitation: The process was interrupted before its normal finalizer; exact end time and run duration were not recorded.
